fills.researcher_notes: COMPANY-LEVEL Operator question, established ONCE for the whole Valley Crossing system in P3667's shard and applied identically here (this is the mainline row; see P3667 for the full evidentiary writeup, repeated in essence: FERC's EA for Docket No. CP17-19-000 names 'Valley Crossing Pipeline, LLC' as the applicant/operator building the border-crossing facility, and naturalgasintel.com independently reports Enbridge's Valley Crossing Pipeline entering service). The wiki's candidate 'Enbridge Energy Pipeline Co' could not be verified as a real legal entity and was not carried across. This row's own StartLocation (Agua Dulce) / EndLocation (Gulf of Mexico) matches the FERC EA's description of the project running from the Nueces County header system near Corpus Christi to the Gulf of Mexico border-crossing facility, confirming this row and the FERC docket describe the same physical system. Sheet Owner is already 'Enbridge [100.%]', consistent with -- not in conflict with -- Operator = Valley Crossing Pipeline, LLC (Enbridge's wholly-owned project entity). Operator is written 'Valley Crossing Pipeline, LLC' by the source; spelled the ownership team's way as 'Valley Crossing Pipeline LLC'.
